title: Integration tests against a disposable Postgres container
demonstrates: daemon-managed resources outside the process group
label-based cleanup after success, failure or cancel

steps.script:
docker run -d --label codespace-mcp.job=$CODESPACE_MCP_JOB_ID --name "pg-$CODESPACE_MCP_JOB_ID" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test -p 127.0.0.1::5432 postgres:16
for i in $(seq 1 60); do docker exec "pg-$CODESPACE_MCP_JOB_ID" pg_isready -U postgres && exit 0; sleep 1; done
echo "postgres never became ready" >&2; exit 1

port=$(docker port "pg-$CODESPACE_MCP_JOB_ID" 5432/tcp | head -1 | sed 's/.*://')
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://postgres:test@127.0.0.1:$port/postgres" python3 -m pytest tests/integration
